package main

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"

	"go.temporal.io/server/tools/gomad/internal/backends/wasm/wasi"
)

type testCase struct {
	Name    string `json:"name"`
	Module  string `json:"module"`
	Fuel    uint64 `json:"fuel"`
	Memory  uint64 `json:"memory_bytes"`
	Wall    uint64 `json:"wall_millis"`
	Modeled bool   `json:"modeled"`
}

func main() {
	helper := flag.String("helper", "", "authenticated frozen helper")
	corpus := flag.String("corpus", "", "shared corpus")
	output := flag.String("output", "", "new reference output directory")
	flag.Parse()
	if err := run(*helper, *corpus, *output); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}

func run(helper, corpus, output string) error {
	helperBytes, err := os.ReadFile(helper)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	helperHash := sha256.Sum256(helperBytes)
	if hex.EncodeToString(helperHash[:]) != "b25439140f0c850a82f99471c9fd48ac864569a75e407a76850873f6ece055a1" {
		return fmt.Errorf("frozen helper identity mismatch")
	}
	if info, err := os.Lstat(helper); err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
		return fmt.Errorf("frozen helper is not a regular file")
	}
	input, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(corpus, "foundation-execution.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var document struct {
		Profile  string     `json:"profile"`
		ReadStep uint64     `json:"read_step_nanos"`
		Seeds    []uint64   `json:"seeds"`
		Cases    []testCase `json:"cases"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(input, &document); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(document.Seeds) != 2 || len(document.Cases) != 6 {
		return fmt.Errorf("incomplete reference corpus")
	}
	if err := os.Mkdir(output, 0700); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	rows := []map[string]any{}
	for _, test := range document.Cases {
		for _, seed := range document.Seeds {
			module, err := filepath.Abs(filepath.Join(corpus, test.Module))
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			bytes, err := os.ReadFile(module)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			moduleHash := sha256.Sum256(bytes)
			config := wasi.Config{Profile: document.Profile, WorkingDirectory: "/", Environment: []string{"PWD=/"}, Clock: wasi.ClockPolicy{ReadStepNanos: document.ReadStep}, Limits: wasi.Limits{OutputBytes: 1024, TranscriptBytes: 4096, Calls: 100, Descriptors: 16, Files: 16, FilesystemBytes: 4096, PendingEvents: 16}}
			request := wasi.Request{HelperPath: helper, HelperSHA256: hex.EncodeToString(helperHash[:]), ModulePath: module, ModuleSHA256: hex.EncodeToString(moduleHash[:]), Engine: wasi.PinnedEngine(), InitialMemoryPages: 1, MemoryBytes: test.Memory, Fuel: test.Fuel, Config: config, Timeout: time.Duration(test.Wall) * time.Millisecond}
			if test.Name == "memory" {
				request.InitialMemoryPages = 2
			}
			if test.Modeled {
				request.Config.Args = []string{"fixture"}
				for _, function := range []struct {
					Name   string
					Params []string
				}{{"fd_write", []string{"i32", "i32", "i32", "i32"}}, {"clock_time_get", []string{"i32", "i64", "i32"}}, {"args_sizes_get", []string{"i32", "i32"}}, {"random_get", []string{"i32", "i32"}}} {
					request.Imports = append(request.Imports, wasi.Import{Module: "wasi_snapshot_preview1", Name: function.Name, Params: function.Params, Results: []string{"i32"}})
				}
			}
			result, err := wasi.Run(context.Background(), request)
			if err != nil {
				return fmt.Errorf("%s.seed%d: %w", test.Name, seed, err)
			}
			raw, err := json.Marshal(result)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			filename := fmt.Sprintf("%s-seed%d.json", test.Name, seed)
			if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output, filename), raw, 0600); err != nil {
				return err
			}
			termination := result.Termination
			if result.WatchdogTimeout {
				termination = "watchdog_timeout"
			}
			row := map[string]any{"name": test.Name, "seed": seed, "termination": termination, "raw_termination": result.Termination, "watchdog": result.WatchdogTimeout, "exit_code": result.ExitCode, "helper_sha256": hex.EncodeToString(helperHash[:]), "module_sha256": hex.EncodeToString(moduleHash[:]), "raw_result": filename, "raw_sha256": fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(raw)), "source_revision": "1d7b37f00a74a85399993f1edcad6fe742e778e3"}
			rows = append(rows, row)
		}
	}
	result := map[string]any{"schema": "gomad.foundation-go-reference/v1", "corpus_sha256": fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(input)), "records": rows}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(result)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(output, "reference.json"), encoded, 0600); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	fmt.Println(string(encoded))
	return nil
}
